mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 7.0% signals improving labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not cross below 7.0% frequently enough to produce statistically significant positive 20-day returns (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in demand (GDPC1) and fall in supply (INDPRO) indicates over-demand, compressing prices and boosting equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > previous month's value AND INDPRO < previous month's value
failure_condition: The GDPC1-INDPRO interaction does not occur frequently enough or fails to produce statistically significant positive returns (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals monetary tightening, raising borrowing costs and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS do not consistently exceed 4.0% or produce statistically significant negative returns (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (rising FEDFUNDS), a drop in demand (GDPC1) amplifies concerns about economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The FEDFUNDS-GDPC1 interaction occurs outside the tightening cycle or fails to produce negative returns when expected (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the supply index (INDPRO) reflects robust production and inventory growth, boosting corporate earnings and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not rise sufficiently or fails to produce statistically significant positive returns over the 5-day horizon (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in demand (GDPC1) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strong economic expansion, enhancing corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > previous month's value AND UNRATE < previous month's value
failure_condition: The GDPC1-UNRATE interaction does not occur frequently enough or fails to produce statistically significant positive returns over the 60-day horizon (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-driven expansion (rising INDPRO), sustained growth in production and inventory levels reduces pressure on corporate margins, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not rise sufficiently during supply-driven expansions or fails to produce statistically significant positive returns over the 5-day horizon (p > 0.05 in t-test).
